pages.text: Tectonic and Terralith shape the terrain: real mountain ranges, deep valleys, long rivers, high plateaus. Biomes O' Plenty fills them. Distant Horizons shows the far side of the valley from your door.$(br2)The capital sits in a lowland. Mountains are where the zinc is; dry country is where the gold is.

Rivers and coasts matter: ships (Eureka) and wagons are how goods move before rails exist. Build towns where water and road meet.$(br2)Structory scatters ruins; Create Structures leave old workshops with parts in them. Pirates hold the coasts.
$(bold)Nature's Compass$() finds a biome by name: the way to the nearest snowy peak, savanna or desert. It is how you find the places bosses live.$(br2)Craft one before the first long trip.
Right-click to open the biome list, pick one, follow the needle. It cannot find structures; that is what rumours and maps are for.
